title: Rigorous characterization of continuous-variable quantum states via optical parametric amplifiers
summary: Characterizing non-Gaussian quantum states is of paramount importance for continuous-variable quantum information processing, yet conventional homodyne-measurement-based state tomography remains limited by optical loss, detector efficiency, and measurement bandwidth. Here, we introduce an integrated framework for loss-tolerant characterization and certification using high-gain phase-sensitive optical parametric amplification and power measurements.
